# Flagon icons

Upload-ready copies of the Flagon mark. Generated by `npm run brand:icons`
(`scripts/brand-icons.mjs`) from the geometry in `public/brand/flagon-mark.svg`;
don't edit these by hand, change the script and rerun it.

**light** = for a light background (dark glass). **dark** = for a dark background (light glass).

| File | What it is | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `avatar-{light,dark}-{120,256,512,1024}.png` | Mark on a solid white / black square, padded for a circular crop | GitHub org and app avatars, Google OAuth consent screen (120), Google Workspace, Slack, social profiles |
| `avatar-{light,dark}.svg` | Same, as vector | Anywhere that accepts SVG |
| `mark-{light,dark}-{256,512,1024}.png` | Bare mark, transparent background, trimmed tight | Placing on a background you control: decks, docs, partner pages |
| `mark-{light,dark}.svg` | Same, as vector | Same |

When a site only takes one image, use `avatar-dark-1024.png`.
